title: Overpriced
text: Overpriced. This product is well made, but very overpriced for plastic. There is a bag of "hardware" that comes with this. Some is not intuitive as to it's use. The descriptive pictures really don't show you much. I assume the rolls are removed from the box and inserted in the dispenser. There is a round hole in the acrylic panel that defies logic. I guess it is for sticking your finger in to remove the end with the magnets. Could be more user friendly.

product_metadata.title: 3 in 1 Clear Acrylic Wrap Foil Wax Dispenser with Slide Cutter , Wrap Foil Wax Organizer for Kitchen Drawer or Wall Mounting, Fits 12" Roll
features: [Wrap Dispenser with 3 Slots] With 3 slots,you can put plastic wrap, aluminum foil and wax paper into the organizer.
[Compatible With Most Wraps] Compatible with plastic wrap, aluminum foil and wax paper rolls that are no wider than 12”.
[2 Ways to Store Wrap]You can put the dispenser into the drawer or mount on the wall according to your needs.Please make sure the drawer has a larger size than 14”*6”*3”.

[Convenient to Put Wrap] There are four magnets on the side of the organizer.Just move the lid of the side to put the wrap into the organizer.Besides,with the clear acrylic material,you can know when to change the wrap.
[Built-In Slide Cutter] With sliding cutter and roll for every slot, it makes a clean cut of wrap,foil and wax.It is really a must for you to store and dispense the kitchen supplies.
